resources.string: AdAway provides two ad blocking methods. Pick the one you like:

Either the su binary could not be found or you did not allow root permission for AdAway.\n\nThis can happen when your device is not rooted. You can find information about how to root your device on wiki.lineageos.org or other Android websites.
AdAway detected that another VPN has the "Always-on VPN" setting active.\n\nThis prevents AdAway from requesting VPN access. Please disable "Always-on VPN" on the correspondent VPN and try again.

AdAway failed to request VPN access.\n\nThis might be caused because another VPN has the "Always-on VPN" setting active. Please, check if any VPN has this setting enabled and disable it before trying again.
AdAway downloads ad networks to block from online sources. You can customize them later in the settings.
It can send notifications to display ad block status and control, and to notify about available app update (a few per year). Enable them if you want to stay up-to-date.
The block lists haven\'t finished downloading. You can continue now and it will keep going in the background, or wait here until it\'s done.
Android can pause AdAway\'s VPN in the background to save power, which can silently stop ad blocking. Allow AdAway to ignore battery optimization so it keeps running.
You can always change this later from
One more thing: your phone\'s own battery manager
Some phone brands have their own battery manager that can also block AdAway. Here\'s what to check on yours:
Could not open the app info screen. Open it manually from Android Settings → Apps → AdAway.
These are general pointers, not an exact guide: the wording and location can vary by phone model and Android version.
Look for something like “Background usage limits” › “Never sleeping apps”, then add AdAway to that list.
Also check for an “Auto optimization” setting and turn off “Restart when needed” if present.
Also enable “Autostart” (“Background autostart” on newer versions).
Choose “Allow background activity” (sometimes shown as “No restrictions”).
Also look for an “Auto-launch” toggle for AdAway (often under Settings › Apps), so it can restart itself after being force-stopped.
Look for “App launch”, turn off “Manage automatically”, then enable all 3: “Auto-launch”, “Secondary launch” and “Run in background”.
Also lock AdAway in the Recents screen (swipe down on its card until a padlock appears).
Look for a background power option and choose “Don\'t restrict background power usage” (not “Smart control”).
Also look for an “Autostart” setting for AdAway, often under Settings › Applications.
Look in app info for a battery or background activity setting and make sure AdAway is not restricted.
